rationale: The papers 'C/O Ratio Studies in the atmosphere of hot Jupiters', 'Cloudy and Cloud-free Thermal Phase Curves with PICASO', and 'Confirmation of sub-solar metallicity for WASP-77Ab from JWST thermal emission spectroscopy' provide insights into the C/O ratios and cloud compositions in exoplanet atmospheres, contributing evidence relevant to the question.
